questions.question: What is media arts?
choices: Creative work using forms such as images, sound, video, animation, or interactive media

questions.question: What is a storyboard used for?
choices: Plan a sequence of images or shots before production

questions.question: What does framing determine in an image or video?
choices: What is included or excluded within the view

questions.question: Why is sound important in a media project?
choices: It has no effect on meaning
It can provide information, mood, rhythm, or emphasis

questions.question: A video uses a low camera angle looking up at a subject. What effect can this create?
choices: The subject may appear powerful or imposing

questions.question: What does editing do in a video project?
choices: Selects and arranges footage, sound, and timing into a sequence

questions.question: Why should a media creator consider the intended audience?
choices: Audience affects content, tone, accessibility, and format choices
It removes the need for a purpose

questions.question: What is copyright?
choices: Legal protection for an original work and its creator's rights

questions.question: A student wants to include a song in a public video. What should they check?
choices: Permission or license terms and attribution requirements
Whether the title matches the video

questions.question: What is one benefit of captions in a video?
choices: They support access for viewers who are deaf or hard of hearing and can clarify speech
They guarantee every claim is true
They change the video frame rate

questions.question: A creator edits a quote so that it reverses the speaker's meaning. What is the concern?
choices: The video has too many transitions
The caption font is too large

questions.question: What is visual hierarchy in a media design?
choices: The order of actors in a cast
The legal status of a work
How visual elements guide attention by size, contrast, placement, or emphasis

questions.question: Why might a creator use a close-up shot?
choices: To establish every location at once

questions.question: What is a transition in video editing?
choices: A technique that connects one shot or scene to another

questions.question: A media project presents a statistic. What should the creator include?
choices: Reliable source information and context for interpreting it
A claim with no date or source

questions.question: How can color grading affect a film scene?
choices: It automatically improves the camera focus
It can shape tone, atmosphere, and visual continuity

questions.question: Why should creators review a project before sharing it?
choices: To check clarity, accuracy, permissions, accessibility, and technical quality

questions.question: A photo is cropped to remove important context. What should a viewer consider?
choices: The crop may change how the image is interpreted

questions.question: What is an interactive media work?
choices: A work where a user's choices or actions affect the experience

questions.question: Which question best evaluates a media artwork?
choices: How long did the creator spend?
How do choices in image, sound, sequence, and audience interaction support its purpose?
